description: Read-only Allocation History card on Order Detail page with paginated table, filters (status, item, location, date range), and status color badges.

controller.note: Add endpoint to existing OrdersController class

requiredSamples.featureSchema:
// frontend/src/features/orders/data/allocation-schema.ts
import { z } from 'zod'

export const allocationRecordSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  itemCode: z.string(),
  itemName: z.string(),
  locationCode: z.string().nullable(),
  locationName: z.string().nullable(),
  warehouseCode: z.string(),
  lotCode: z.string().nullable(),
  allocatedQtyKg: z.number(),
  allocationMethod: z.string(),
  status: z.string(),
  expiresAt: z.string().nullable(),
  createdTime: z.string(),
  createdBy: z.string(),
})

export type AllocationRecord = z.infer<typeof allocationRecordSchema>

export const AllocationStatusOptions = ['Active', 'Released', 'Expired', 'Cancelled', 'Completed'] as const

export interface AllocationRecordFilters {
  statuses?: string[]
  item?: string
  location?: string
  fromDate?: string
  toDate?: string
  page?: number
  pageSize?: number
}
